waypoints.name: Snow Lake Trailhead
waypoints.note: On Stevens Canyon Road ~1.5 mi east of Reflection Lakes, Mount Rainier NP; follow the Snow Lake trail then ascend the upper basin toward the saddle west of the peak.
waypoints.directions: From the Nisqually Entrance on SR 706, follow the park road past Longmire about 15.4 miles and turn right onto Stevens Canyon Road just below Paradise. Drive about 3.6 miles east, past Reflection Lakes, to the small Snow Lake trailhead lot on the right. Stevens Canyon Road is open only in summer, and a park entrance pass is required.

waypoints.name: Unicorn Peak Summit
waypoints.note: Shared high point for all Unicorn Peak routes.
waypoints.directions: Hike the Snow Lake Trail about a mile to Snow Lake, then take the climbers' path up the northwest talus gully into the basin and climb the moraine beside the basin snowfield to Unicorn Col. Traverse east below the summit cliffs on the south side to the horn. The Roof starts about 20 ft left of the Classic Route, where the ridgeline meets the block: climb the gully beneath the roof, step right onto a ledge and continue to the top.
